contract: Project: 5-page website for a bakery (Home, Menu, About, Gallery, Contact). Fixed price: $800. Includes two rounds of design revisions. Excluded: online ordering, payment integration, blog, hosting management.
thread:
Alex: Hi Maya, the first draft of the 5-page site is ready for review.
Maya: Thanks! Can you change the banner colour to dark green? The current one is too bright.
Alex: Done, updated.
Maya: Looks lovely. Can you add online ordering so customers can order cakes?
Alex: Online ordering is outside the current scope. I can send a quote if you like.
Maya: Hmm, let me think about it.
Maya: Also, please add a small WhatsApp reserve button, just a link, no extra cost.
Alex: I can look at that. A Bengali version of the site would be $150 extra. Shall I proceed?
Maya: Sounds good, go ahead with the Bengali version!
Alex: Great, starting on it.
Maya: Actually, forget the Bengali version. Not needed.
Maya: Can you add a blog section for our recipes?
Alex: A blog is not included in the contract either; I can quote it.
Maya: How much would that be?
Alex: I'll send a quote tomorrow.
Maya: Thanks, looks great! 😀
